The name Samaa is also used in reference to the highest heavenly realm of the universe, where Allah is believed to reside.

The name conveys a sense of tranquility and calmness, invoking images of the peaceful sky and the peaceful nature of Allah. It is a name that inspires awe, reverence, and a desire to connect with the divine. The name Samaa also represents a connection to the divine through the practice of listening to the recitation of the Quran, which is believed to bring the listener closer to Allah.
